history.phase: V1.1.0 release candidate plus scheduler slice 1
history.verification: Traced the reported defects to two code paths: a successful-but-empty live response cleared PLAYING (freeing both players mid-match and re-offering the same game), and restoreDispatchState silently discarded a marker duty whose game key did not resolve to exactly one current fixture. Corrected both: PLAYING is retained until recorded completion, live records with no fixture row commit their resolved players, completion releases players/marker/board and persists it, game identity carries the fixture date and saved duties carry their own pair so a restore re-finds a re-keyed match, and an unresolvable duty is retained and shown for explicit release. node test/parse-check.cjs (312 checks) and node test/scheduler-check.cjs (694 checks) both exited 0; 12 new live-night scenarios added; local Chromium harness confirmed the retained-duty affordance and its one-click release.
